profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Stoke Space | Boltline
profile.summary:
I am a seasoned software engineer, with broad experience in service and application development, in a variety of platforms ranging from embedded devices to cloud, with a strong focus on quality and delightful customer experience. I have a desire to continuously learn about technologies and techniques, and drive both to be able to quickly contribute to the team, as well as diving deep into the details and nuances of the platform to increase and broaden impact.

#YAGNI #DRY #SOLID

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
(TypeScript, Kotlin, AWS) Amazon Leo for Government (formerly known as Kuiper Government solutions) - Implemented several changes to code and infrastructure to complete the Amazon Security Review certification. Led the engineering work towards the NIST 800-53r5 cybersecurity certification. In both cases, this includes many interventions in the AWS infrastructure as code (using CDK and CloudFormation) to ensure the security requirements like IAM least-privilege principles, encryption at rest and in transit, audit logging, and defense-in-depth strategies, are met and the product can be certified for government contracts for the tightly regulated aerospace sector.

Several AWS technologies were used to meet regulatory requirements, like: VPC, IAM, KMS, S3, Lambda, RDS, ECS/Fargate, CloudWatch, and CloudTrail. Comprehensive monitoring and alerting were added as part of the work, least-privilege and block-by-default-allow-by-exception, as well as network segmentation, automated key rotation, among other techniques/technologies.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS CloudFormation · Kotlin · TypeScript · AWS Lambda · AWS Identity and Access Management (AWS IAM) · NIST 800-53 · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · Cybersecurity · CDK · ITAR · FedRAMP

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
(C#) API Benchmarking – Built a pipeline for performance testing, reporting, and monitoring, to enable all teams to seamlessly create and integrate their own tests, and regression protection/monitoring.

(C++/C#) Dynamics Finance & Operations, Dataverse – Delivered major security fix, coordinating 4 different teams across and over 200 files. Crash dump investigations, performance investigations and optimizations, bug fixing, operations, implementation, and analysis of performance telemetry as part of extensive on-call experience, handling critical issues for F500 companies and improving serviceability, high-availability and fault tolerance.

(Java) Yammer – Implemented a data pump component, enabling customers in regulated industries like banks and insurance to onboard M365. Implemented GraphQL backend and introduced support for multi-tenant search. Created a pipeline to support the localization for the whole Yammer team. Influenced the M365 leadership to replace a deprecated PDF converter.

(ReactJS) Outlook Web (frontend) – Developed Group Search feature, fixed long-lasting issues in the rest of the Outlook Web product by deep-diving on web stack documentation.

(C++) Outlook Desktop – Targeted bug fixing on Groups experience and created a notification framework made available to the entire Outlook Desktop product.

(C#) Groups Guests feature – Integrated the deep link customizations to a brand-new throttling framework.

(C#) Public Folders features and improvements – Salvaged storage management feature that was failing in production. Investigated and fixed bugs, refactored code to enable more tests and scenarios, increased code coverage by 20x, decreased the test execution time by 75%. Improved response time from 3+ days to 5 minutes, increased reliability from <10%  to close to 100%. Developed a feature that reclaims unused storage with high focus on quality, due to customer data loss risk. Both features have been working for years without any new fixes.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer in Tests
positions.description:
(C, C++, C#) Multiple versions of Exchange Server – Most relevant work was on a highly visible task force that addressed severe issues in the Public Folders Hierarchy Sync feature, working closely with partner teams to guide, through the results of performance experiments, performance improvements in the product.

In other occasions, developed performance test plans and automation to validate compliance features (Mailbox Auditing), localization and accessibility tests (Outlook Groups), security (Windows SMTP server), as well as functional test planning and automation of several areas of the product.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Prior to joining Microsoft, I worked for major employers in Porto Digital tech hub in Recife, Brazil:

- Flash/J2EE collaborative layout tool for Embraer Legacy jet
- J2ME/C++ Application development for Motorola cellular phones
- C/C++ Embedded development for Motorola cellular phones (application platform and Java VM)
- C/C++ Development of Field Force Automation applications for PalmOS, development of mobile application framework for PalmOS, development of an embedded relational database engine.
- Online games (NetPong, NetChess) and online gaming platform (Coliseum - https://web.archive.org/web/19980520003847/http://coliseum.com.br)

positions.title: Research Assistant, Teacher's Assistant, Associate Professor
positions.description:
* Universidade Federal de Pernambuco:
- Research assistant and Teacher's assistant in Databases & Database Theory
- Researcher in Computer Engineering

- Research assistant and Teacher's assistant in Distance Learning & Education - I worked for several years with distance learning projects, including KidLink, teaching computer fundamentals to all professors from the Teaching Certificate programs at Universidade Federal de Pernambuco, all School Teachers of City of Recife municipal public schools, and state School Teachers from the Brazilian Northeast.
- As part of the engineering side of the education project, I set up and administered 2 computer labs, including network and PC setup, email, web server, FTP server, using Windows workstations and Linux servers.

* Universidade Salgado de Oliveira:
- Associate professor - Introduced and taught 3 classes: "Introduction to Computer Programming", "Computer Programming 1" and "Computer Programming 2", where I achieved high engagement of the students by using simple videogames as class projects.

projects.title: Personal coding projects
projects.description:
Some random personal projects I worked on as means to remain active on specific platforms. The list is bigger than that, but these are the ones I marked as public so far.

(C) SeeSharprKAF - Kilo(byte) Application  Framework is a set of OS independent libraries (intended for small memory footprint on embedded systems) that are inspired by code that I wrote originally on PalmOS. The goal was to rebuild the relational DBMS I wrote for the Palm III device a long time ago, more like a memento than an actual code that I was intended to run again,  but improved with some techniques I learned later in life - https://seesharpr.visualstudio.com/_git/SeeSharprKAF

(C/Assembly) 8051 Real-time Task Scheduler - This was an interesting learning project where I had to get creative to overcome the limitations of the 8051 timer supporting only 16-bit hardware counters to extend it to 32-bit software-based interruption clock.
https://github.com/SeeSharpr/8051

(ReactJS) SharprHunt - Simple treasure hunt that I built on React to spend Halloween indoors during the 2020 lockdown - https://seesharpr.visualstudio.com/_git/SharprHunt (live at https://sharpr-hunt.netlify.app/, but without the physical clues it doesn't make much sense).
